# f5xc_cdn_cache_rule (Resource)

CDN cache rule CDN cache rule view defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage CDN cache rule. It can be used to create CDN cache rule.

To get more information about f5xc_cdn_cache_rule, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/cdn-cache-rule)
